Hymn 228: You Can Make the Pathway Bright
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major

This is hymn number 228 titled "You Can Make the Pathway Bright" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by James M. Black and the lyrics were written by Helen Silcott Dungan.
